# DIY Nifty Midcap 150 Momentum Index (V3 / R3)

> Plain-text & static AI-readable mirror (as of 2026-11-27) of the live quantitative dashboard at https://harjaschadha.github.io/midcap-momentum-index/. Personal Quantitative Research & Paper-Trading Sandbox — Not Investment Advice / Not SEBI Registered.

## Why Read Here
- The interactive dashboard at https://harjaschadha.github.io/midcap-momentum-index/ renders purely via client-side JavaScript (`assets/app.js` fetching `data/live_state.json`).
- Web AI fetchers without JavaScript execution should read `llms-full.txt` or `/ai/` below, which contain 100% of the live numbers, orders, Top-60 rankings, Paper Bot ledgers, and verified backtest tables directly in plain text / semantic HTML.
